butcher_attempt.note: One Butchery attempt at a node, a hit or a miss. The cue repeats until the gathering stops.

cut_attempt.note: One Cutting attempt at a node, a hit or a miss. The cue repeats until the gathering stops.

foundry_craft.note: One finished craft under Foundry. The cue repeats until the batch stops.

guns_shot.note: One shot of a weapon whose combat style reads Guns, a hit or a miss. The shooter hears it.

level_up.note: A level of a skill rose. The client cues it from SkillsState.levelled, not from a moment.

melee_swing.note: One melee swing, a hit or a miss. Each melee style reads Strike, a fist included. The attacker hears it.

metalsmith_craft.note: One finished craft under Metalsmith. The cue repeats until the batch stops.

task_complete.note: The last kill of an Exterminator task.

transition.note: A transition tile moved the player to its target tile. The player who moved hears it.
